dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Berî hilberînê, rêza dirûn, rengên têlan, bazdan, qutkirin, û fermanên makîneyê bikole. Dîzaynê dirû bi dirû pêşdîtin bike, şêwazên nîşandanê biguherîne, û tiştê ku dibînî derxe.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Simulasyona dirûnê ya înteraktîf, vekolîn, û derxistin.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Rêberekê li hember ekranê bigire û sliderê bikşîne heya ku barê jêr tam 100 mm be, paşê OK bikirtîne.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Wêneya bi çareseriya tam kopî bike bo panoya têketinê

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Ziman wek {language} hate danîn. Ma tu dixwazî niha InkSim ji nû ve dest pê bikî?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Zimanê standard ê pergalê dê were bikaranîn. Ma tu dixwazî niha InkSim ji nû ve dest pê bikî?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: هەموو پەنجەرە کراوەکانی InkSim دادەخرێن و فایلی ئێستا دووبارە دەکرێتەوە.

dialog.open.not_embroidery.translation: Ev ne pelgeyek embroidery ya derbasdar e.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_failed.translation: Derxistina CSV ya Ink/Stitch têk çû.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Ji bo hûrguliyên xeletiyê li output.err binêre.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Dema derxistina CSV ya Ink/Stitch qediya.

dialog.open_browser.converting.translation: Derxistina CSV ya Ink/Stitch tê meşandin...

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Vê SVG-yê di paceyeke nû ya Inkscape de veke.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Di vê peldankê de pelên piştgirîkirî tune ne.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Ji bo gerîna pelên wê, li peldankê du caran bitikîne.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Ji bo gerîna pelên wê, li peldankê du caran bitikîne.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Ji bo sererastkirina pelên SVG, Inkscape pêwîst e.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured active Ink/Stitch installation is required for SVG preview.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Ji bo pêşdîtina SVG-yê, sazkirineke çalak û mîhengkirî ya Ink/Stitch pêwîst e.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG using the active Ink/Stitch installation.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Bi sazkirina çalak a Ink/Stitch ji vê SVG-yê daneyên dirûtinê çêbike.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Nikarî skrîpta Ink/Stitch ya çalak an jî pelê destpêkerê Python-ê yê mîhengkirî bixebitîne.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Pêvekera Ink/Stitch: kontrol nehat kirin. Ji bo dîsa ceribandinê Amûr... bikar bîne.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Pêvekera Ink/Stitch: di peldankên pêvekeran ên Inkscape de nehat dîtin.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Pêvekera Ink/Stitch: heta Inkscape neyê mîhengkirin nayê kontrolkirin.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Pêvekera Ink/Stitch: hîn nehatiye kontrolkirin. Ji bo kontrolkirinê Amûr... bikar bîne.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; editing requires Inkscape.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.translation: Pêşdîtina SVG rasterast bi Ink/Stitch tê meşandin; ji bo sererastkirinê Inkscape pêwîst e.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; Inkscape is used only for editing.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.translation: Pêşdîtina SVG rasterast bi Ink/Stitch tê meşandin; Inkscape tenê ji bo sererastkirinê tê bikaranîn.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Çavkaniya SVG. Ji bo pêşdîtina dirûtinê Inkscape pêwîst e.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Çavkaniya SVG. Pêşdîtinê hilbijêre da ku bi Inkscape/Ink/Stitch daneyên dirûtinê çêbike.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Ev SVG ji bo pêşdîtinê li vir pir mezin e.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Pelê demkî yê pêşdîtinê nehat çêkirin: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Ev cure pel di InkSim de nayê vekirin.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Tu peldankên pêvekerên InkSim nehatin dîtin.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_user_current.translation: Pêvekera bikarhêner ya heyî (armanca sazkirin/nûkirinê): {path} | Rewş: {status}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions.translation: Pêvekerên InkSim saz bike / nû bike

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Pêvekerên InkSim ên Inkscape nehatin sazkirin: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Pêvekerên InkSim ên Inkscape li {path} hatin sazkirin an nûkirin. Ji bo barkirina wan Inkscape ji nû ve veke.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape di rêça pergalê de nehat dîtin.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Ji bo sepandina wergêrê nû yê Python Inkscape ji nû ve veke.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Peldanka kevn a pêvekerên InkSim nehat rakirin: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Peldankên kevn ên pêvekerên InkSim hatin rakirin. Ji bo nûkirina lîsteya pêvekeran Inkscape ji nû ve veke.

integration.inkscape.report.active_inkst.translation: Sazkirina çalak a Ink/Stitch hat nûkirin: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Sazkirina hatî dîtin di mîhengên InkSim de hate tomarkirin.

integration.inkscape.report.executable.translation: Pelê xebatê yê Inkscape hat kontrolkirin: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Amûra destpêkerê ya pêwîst '{command}' nehat dîtin; mîheng bê guhertin hate hiştin.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape nehat dîtin. Ji bo kontrolkirina sazkirinê pelê xebatê hilbijêre.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Wergêrê Python nehat kontrolkirin an nûkirin: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Vebijarka wergêrê Python nehat kontrolkirin, ji ber ku peldanka pêvekerên bikarhêner ne berdest e.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Ji bo sepandina wergêrê nûkirî Inkscape ji nû ve veke.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Inkscape di nav {seconds} çirkeyan de bersiv neda.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Ji bo kontrolkirinê pelê xebatê yê Inkscape hilbijêre.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape di nav {seconds} çirkeyan de bersiv neda. Dibe ku paceyeke din a Inkscape an pêvekerek rê li ber danûstandinê bigire. Paceyên din ên Inkscape bigire an pêvekerê astengker neçalak bike, paşê dîsa biceribîne.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Amûra destpêkerê ya pêwîst '{command}' nehat dîtin. Amûra uvr bi xwe bi `uv tool install uvr` saz bike, paşê vê mîhengkirinê dîsa bimeşîne. InkSim wê saz nake.

menu.view.clear_snap.translation: Cihê snapê ya tomarkirî paqij bike

menu.view.save_snap.translation: Cihê snapê ya niha tomar bike

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Ji bo derxistinê tu pelê dirûnê nehatiye barkirin.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Firehiya xetê û faktorên sihê vesaz bike

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Bikirtîne ji bo eyarkirina faktora tarî, faktora ronahî û firehiya xetê

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Dîtina jêr (dirûnên paşîn di bin yên berê de bikişîne)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Nîşandana bazdanê biguherîne: neçalak, hemû, tenê xeternak
